description: This file defines interfaces related to asynchronous streaming in Orleans, including IAsyncStream<T> and IAsyncStream, which facilitate distributed rendezvous between producers and consumers, supporting subscription management and stream properties.

classes.name: IAsyncStream<T>
classes.description: An interface representing a distributed rendezvous stream that supports subscriptions, comparison, and observable patterns.

classes.name: IAsyncStream
classes.description: An interface representing properties of an asynchronous stream, such as rewindability, provider name, and stream ID.

methods.name: GetAllSubscriptionHandles
methods.description: Retrieves all active subscription handles created by the caller for this stream.
